target.title: fix(memory-wiki): harden bridge imports under concurrent syncs
target.body:
## Summary

- Add bounded retry handling for transient `FsSafeError: path-mismatch` while writing imported memory-wiki source pages.
- Coalesce concurrent bridge imported-source syncs for the same resolved vault/config so `wiki.status`, `wiki.importInsights`, and `wiki.palace` share the same in-flight bridge sync instead of launching duplicate import/index-refresh passes.
- Preserve existing vault safety boundaries for symlink/path-alias and directory-collision cases.
- Rebase the existing PR onto current `origin/main` and keep main's shared guarded page-write path while retaining this PR's imported-source retry and bridge sync coalescing.
- **What did NOT change:** Out of scope and unchanged: no channel delivery, provider routing, plugin-hook contract, gateway method signature, config schema/default, or broad session model change; the behavior change is only the `extensions/memory-wiki` imported-source retry/coalescing path.
- Why it matters / User impact: concurrent memory-wiki bridge imports no longer duplicate expensive import passes or fail the bridge surface on transient filesystem `path-mismatch` races, without weakening path safety.

Related to #91154.

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Bridge-mode memory-wiki imported-source sync runs through the real OpenClaw gateway surface for `wiki.status`, `wiki.importInsights`, `wiki.palace`, and `wiki.bridge.import`; concurrent bridge calls for the same vault/config coalesce to one underlying bridge ingest/index-refresh pass; transient source-page rewrite pressure does not break the gateway or leave the bridge vault inconsistent.
- **Real environment tested:** Linux worktree `/media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/pr-91828`, exact head `263d3858aea0106b5097db1f354b3494046da422`, local `origin/main` ref `6638a575d39dee5e64ecb562695b70affca8f4b4` during the gateway proof. A post-proof daily-fix drift check against `origin/main` `48e8965b1060d61beda1a52d572373a409317498` found no overlapping changed files and `sync_main_required=false`. Runtime used an isolated loopback OpenClaw gateway at `/tmp/openclaw-pr91828-runtime-20260703-proof` with `vaultMode=bridge`, `bridge.readMemoryArtifacts=true`, and a public `MEMORY.md` artifact in the isolated workspace. Secrets and gateway tokens are not included in the evidence or this PR body.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**

```bash
node "/media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-pr-91828-evidence/run-gateway-proof-20260703.mjs"
```

The runner starts an exact-head loopback gateway, calls `wiki.status`, `health`, `wiki.importInsights`, and `wiki.palace`, then launches six concurrent gateway calls (`2 x wiki.status`, `2 x wiki.importInsights`, `2 x wiki.palace`), runs eight `wiki.bridge.import` calls while an external writer repeatedly replaces the generated bridge source page, searches the isolated runtime logs for `path-mismatch`/`FsSafeError`/refusal signals, and finally checks that an unknown-method request fails without destabilizing a follow-up `wiki.status`.

- **Evidence after fix:**

```text

- /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-pr-91828-evidence/focused-vitest-after-sync.log
- /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-pr-91828-evidence/runtime-gateway-proof-summary-after-sync-20260703.txt
- /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-pr-91828-evidence/runtime-gateway-calls-after-sync-20260703.txt
- /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-pr-91828-evidence/runtime-gateway-concurrent-bridge-calls-after-sync-20260703.txt
- /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-pr-91828-evidence/runtime-gateway-path-mismatch-race-attempt-after-sync-20260703.txt
- /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-pr-91828-evidence/runtime-gateway-negative-probe-after-sync-20260703.txt

- Test Files: 3 passed (3)

- Duration: 8.60s

- source_pages=1
- concurrent_ingest_delta=1
- rewrite_import_failures=0
- concurrent_call_failures=0
- path_mismatch_log_matches=0
- unknown_method_exit=1
- followup_status_exit=0
- result=PASS

runtime-gateway-calls-after-sync-20260703.txt:
- wiki.status: exit=0, vaultMode=bridge, bridgePublicArtifactCount=1, pageCounts.source=1, sourceCounts.bridge=1, warnings=[]
- health: exit=0, memory-core and memory-wiki loaded, plugin errors=[]
- wiki.importInsights: exit=0, totalItems=0, totalClusters=0, clusters=[]
- wiki.palace: exit=0, totalPages=10, pageCounts.source=1

runtime-gateway-concurrent-bridge-calls-after-sync-20260703.txt:
- six concurrent calls all exited 0:
  status_a wiki.status 0 1
  status_b wiki.status 0 1
  import_a wiki.importInsights 0 0
  import_b wiki.importInsights 0 0
  palace_a wiki.palace 0 10
  palace_b wiki.palace 0 10
- ingest_count_before=1, ingest_count_after=2, ingest_delta=1
- new ingest details: sourceType=memory-bridge, artifactCount=1, updatedCount=1, skippedCount=0, workspaces=1

runtime-gateway-path-mismatch-race-attempt-after-sync-20260703.txt:
- external writer repeatedly replaced /tmp/openclaw-pr91828-runtime-20260703-proof/wiki/sources/bridge-workspace-4a5899cf-memory-2d62c497.md
- 8 x wiki.bridge.import exited 0
- final wiki.status: bridgePublicArtifactCount=1, pageCounts.source=1, warnings=[]

runtime-gateway-negative-probe-after-sync-20260703.txt:
- wiki.noSuchMethod returned structured INVALID_REQUEST / unknown method and exited 1; the follow-up wiki.status exited 0.
```

- **Observed result after fix:** `wiki.status`, `wiki.importInsights`, `wiki.palace`, and `wiki.bridge.import` all succeed through the real `openclaw gateway call` surface against bridge-mode memory-wiki with one discovered public memory artifact and one generated bridge source page. After a live workspace artifact update, six concurrent gateway calls produced exactly one new bridge ingest log entry, showing that concurrent callers shared one bridge import/index-refresh pass for the same resolved config identity. The atomic source-page rewrite pressure probe did not break imports or final status, and the adjacent unknown-method probe returned a structured gateway error without destabilizing the gateway.
- **What was not tested:** The live race probe did not emit a directly observable `path-mismatch`/`FsSafeError` log signal, so this update does not claim a naturally observed path-mismatch recovery event; it proves the gateway stayed healthy under source-page atomic rewrite pressure and the code-level retry remains bounded to that transient error. I did not rerun the reporter-scale ~1,900-file WSL2/RSS-pressure workload, external channel delivery, or third-party provider/API proof on this head.
- **Fix classification:** Root cause fix

## Review findings addressed

- **RF-001 [P1] exact-head real behavior proof for bridge gateway methods and retry/coalescing behavior:** Addressed for the real gateway surface on exact head `263d3858aea0106b5097db1f354b3494046da422`. `wiki.status`, `wiki.importInsights`, `wiki.palace`, and `wiki.bridge.import` all succeeded against bridge mode with a real public memory artifact; the concurrent six-call probe produced exactly one new ingest entry. Remaining gap: the live rewrite-pressure probe did not naturally surface a `path-mismatch` log/error signal, so that part is disclosed instead of overstated.
- **RF-002 [P1] live/local bridge proof gap:** Addressed with an isolated loopback OpenClaw gateway, memory-core + memory-wiki loaded, `vaultMode=bridge`, `bridge.readMemoryArtifacts=true`, and `bridgePublicArtifactCount=1` from an actual workspace `MEMORY.md` artifact.
- **RF-003 [P1] session-state / coalescing identity risk:** Addressed by the implementation and runtime probe. The coalescing key includes vault path/mode, bridge/ingest/render/search/context/obsidian config, and agent default/list workspace identity; the runtime concurrent batch updated the live artifact once and produced a single ingest delta across six gateway calls.
- **RF-004 [P1] stale gateway-load / reporter-scale proof:** Partially addressed and partially disclosed. This update supplies exact-head local gateway proof and fresh focused Vitest results after the rebase/conflict resolution; it does not claim the reporter's ~1,900-file WSL2/RSS-pressure workload was rerun.
- **RF-005 [maintainer decision] merge-risk / canonical retry acceptance:** Still requires maintainer judgment. This rebase keeps current main's shared `writeGuardedVaultPage` write boundary and keeps this PR focused on imported-source stat/read retry plus bridge import/index-refresh coalescing; maintainers should make the final broad-vs-narrow canonical merge decision.
- **RF-006 [signal] fresh proof / re-review:** This update replaces stale pre-rebase proof with current-head runtime gateway evidence and records it through the daily-fix verification marker. Remaining proof gaps are explicitly listed in `What was not tested` rather than hidden behind local tests.

## Competition / linked PR analysis

- ClawSweeper previously flagged overlap with #94443 on transient `path-mismatch` retry behavior.
- This conflict resolution uses the current main shared `writeGuardedVaultPage` retry behavior for the guarded write boundary and keeps this PR focused on imported-source stat/read retry plus bridge import/index-refresh coalescing.
- This avoids restoring a divergent direct write retry path, but it does not override the remaining maintainer choice about broad-vs-narrow canonical merge direction.

## Regression Test Plan

- **Target test file:** `extensions/memory-wiki/src/bridge.test.ts`, `extensions/memory-wiki/src/source-sync.test.ts`, `extensions/memory-wiki/src/source-page-shared.test.ts`.
- **Scenario locked in:** coalesced concurrent imported-source sync for identical bridge config, separate coalescing identity when workspace inputs differ, transient imported-source `path-mismatch` retry, preserved human Notes, and preserved symlink/path-alias + directory-collision refusal.
- **Command:**

```bash
cd "/media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/pr-91828"
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-memory.config.ts \
  extensions/memory-wiki/src/source-page-shared.test.ts \
  extensions/memory-wiki/src/source-sync.test.ts \
  extensions/memory-wiki/src/bridge.test.ts
```

- **Result:** `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 22 passed (22)` in `/media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-pr-91828-evidence/focused-vitest-after-sync.log`.
- **Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail:** these tests and the runtime gateway proof exercise the memory-wiki import/sync owner boundary that calls `syncImportedSourcesIfNeeded`; they avoid coupling the guardrail to unrelated channel delivery, provider routing, or UI behavior.

## Origin / follow-up

Existing PR tied to #91154. This update rebases the existing PR, resolves the source-page conflict, and revalidates exact head `263d3858aea0106b5097db1f354b3494046da422` through the local gateway surface. After proof, daily-fix rechecked drift against `origin/main` ref `48e8965b1060d61beda1a52d572373a409317498`; there were no overlapping changed files and no sync-main requirement.

## Merge risk

- **Risk labels considered:** `merge-risk: 🚨 session-state`, `extensions: memory-wiki`.
- **Risk explanation:** Behavior change is limited to memory-wiki import/sync coalescing and imported source-page retry; concurrent callers now share one underlying bridge import/index-refresh pass for the same resolved config identity.
- **Why acceptable:** The diff is confined to `extensions/memory-wiki`, coalescing identity includes the bridge artifact-discovery inputs that can change imported source results, and the runtime gateway proof shows repeated/concurrent bridge calls produce one consistent bridge source page and no warnings. Existing symlink/path-alias safety remains outside the retry path.
- **Remaining maintainer decision:** Accept whether this focused imported-source retry/coalescing patch is the desired canonical merge path alongside the broader guarded write behavior already present on main.

## Root Cause

- **Root cause:** Concurrent bridge imported-source syncs for the same vault/config each performed independent artifact-discovery + import/index-refresh passes, and imported source-page stat/read/write treated transient fs-safe `path-mismatch` races as fatal.
- **Why this is root-cause fix:** The fix coalesces at the import/sync source boundary, where bridge artifact discovery and index refresh are owned, and adds bounded retry only for the identified transient filesystem condition rather than masking downstream failures or weakening path safety.
- **Fix classification:** Root cause fix
- **Maintainer-ready confidence:** Medium-high: the exact-head gateway proof covers the bridge surface and concurrent coalescing behavior; confidence is bounded by the disclosed missing natural `path-mismatch` signal and missing reporter-scale WSL2/RSS workload.
- **Patch quality notes:** No skipped-test or lint suppression claims; no broad refactor. The catch/default paths are narrow guard behavior: `path-mismatch` is rethrown into the bounded retry loop, `not-found`/race reads are treated as no preservable existing notes, and the actual write remains guarded by `writeGuardedVaultPage`, so symlink/path-alias safety is not masked.
- **Architecture / source-of-truth check:** Source-of-truth boundary: `source-sync.ts` and `bridge.ts` own bridge artifact discovery, import, and index refresh; `source-page-shared.ts` owns imported source-page retry; `writeGuardedVaultPage` remains the canonical guarded vault write contract from main. Gateway methods are callers of this owner path, not new contract owners.
